autonomous_boiler_design_page.section1_text: Our company performs the complete scope of engineering and survey works and drafts design documentation in strict compliance with Russian Government Decree No. 87, from drafting terms of reference to securing positive approvals from state or independent expert review bodies and obtaining all necessary construction permits.
autonomous_boiler_design_page.intro_definition: An autonomous gas boiler house is a building or specialized room housing equipment for hot water or steam generation to meet facility energy demands. Modern boiler rooms also offer the option of cogeneration technology (simultaneous generation of electricity and heat).
autonomous_boiler_design_page.types_intro: We provide engineering design services for the following types of industrial gas boiler houses:
autonomous_boiler_design_page.advantages_title: Advantages of an In-House Boiler Plant:
autonomous_boiler_design_page.adv1: Thermal energy at real cost price, avoiding utility markups and elevated regional grid tariffs;
autonomous_boiler_design_page.adv2: Precise automated weather-compensated output regulation, maximizing fuel savings;
autonomous_boiler_design_page.adv3: Possibility of integrating cogeneration and trigeneration, significantly boosting overall energy efficiency;
autonomous_boiler_design_page.adv4: Potential to sell excess heat and electrical power to external third-party consumers (subject to utility supplier status);
autonomous_boiler_design_page.adv5: Investment incentives and accelerated depreciation reducing corporate income tax liabilities.
autonomous_boiler_design_page.bmk_banner_title: Where required, Energy Plus engineers provide complete design, fabrication, and supply of block-modular boiler houses (BMK) with capacities from 0.3 to 8 MW
autonomous_boiler_design_page.smr_box_text: LLC Energy Plus performs turnkey construction and installation works for developed engineering designs in full compliance with SNiP standards.
